name: Duelist
text: Footwork: once per turn, after you hit with a melee attack, move 5 ft × ½ DEX. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Riposte (½ STR/S.R.): reaction, when a melee attack misses you: make one melee weapon attack against the attacker.
lore: Footwork drilled until it needs no thought. The blade goes where the eyes already are.

name: Templar
text: Oath (½ WIL/S.R.): reaction, when an attack hits an ally within 5 ft: you take its damage instead, reduced by 2 × STR.
lore: A vow, a shield arm and a spine that does not bend. Others stand behind this one.

name: Spellblade
text: Battle Caster: a weapon you hold counts as an empty Hand for casting from a Spellbook. Spell Strike (½ STR/S.R.): when you hit with a melee weapon attack: +INT damage.
lore: Steel in one hand, a spell on the tongue. Taught that the two were never separate.

name: Infiltrator
text: Unseen: your checks to sneak, pick locks and spot traps add both DEX and INT.
lore: Locks, ledges and the patience of a held breath. Nobody remembers seeing them leave.

name: Performer
text: Crowd Work (½ DEX/S.R.): reaction, after an ally within 30 ft rolls an attack or a check: +WIL to that roll.
lore: Quick feet and a quicker smile. Every room is a stage, every fight an audience.

name: Sage
text: Learned: ½ INT extra spell points. Your checks to recall lore add both INT and WIL.
lore: A mind that kept every page it ever read, and a voice that makes the pages speak.

name: Brawler
text: Scrapper: +STR to hit with Grapples and Shoves. Slip Free: your Escape attacks add 2 × DEX instead of STR or DEX.
lore: Taverns, docks and pit fights. Swords are for people who can't hold on.

name: Zealot
text: Righteous Fury (½ WIL/S.R.): when you hit with a weapon attack: +½ STR d6 Radiant damage.
lore: A fire that won't go out, and a cause worth burning for. Doubt is for other people.

name: Tactician
text: Command (½ STR/S.R.): action. An ally within 30 ft who can hear you takes the Attack action at once, with +INT to hit.
lore: Every fight is a board, every ally a piece. They see the move three turns before it lands.

name: Ranger
text: Quarry (½ INT/S.R.): when you hit a creature with a ranged attack, it's marked: you and your allies have +½ DEX on attacks against it until the start of your next turn.
lore: Weeks alone on a trail, and an arrow that never wastes its flight.

name: Trickster
text: Feint (½ WIL/S.R.): reaction, when an attack hits you: −DEX to that attack roll, possibly turning it into a miss.
lore: Never where you swing. Always where you look away. The grin is the last thing you see.

name: Hermit
text: Solitude: ½ WIL extra Resolve. Your checks to forage and endure add both INT and WIL.
lore: Years in a cave or a forest, talking to stones and stars. Something out there answered.

name: Leather
lore: Supple hide, oiled and stitched. It creaks a little, but it lets you run.

name: Mail
lore: Riveted rings over a padded coat. Heavy on the shoulders, light on the conscience.

name: Plate
lore: Full steel, fitted to you. You hear yourself coming, and so does everyone else.

name: Shield
text: Takes one Hand.
lore: Oak boards, an iron rim, a dented boss. Every scar on it is a blow you never felt.

name: Dagger
text: +2 to hit, thrown 20/60 ft, 1d4 + DEX Physical.
lore: Every traveler carries one. It cuts bread, rope and, when it must, throats.

name: Shortsword
text: +2 to hit, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical.
lore: A short, honest blade for tight alleys and crowded fights.

name: Handaxe
text: +2 to hit, thrown 20/60 ft, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical.
lore: A woodcutter's tool that learned a second trade. It flies true when thrown.

name: Finesse Blade
text: +2 to hit, 1d6 + DEX Physical. Sap: when you hit, the target has −2 on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
lore: A slim duelist's sword. A nick here, a cut there, and the foe's arm grows slow.

name: Longsword
text: +2 to hit, 1d8 / 1d10 + STR Physical.
lore: The knight's blade: one hand for the shield, two hands when the shield breaks.

name: Battleaxe
text: +2 to hit, 1d8 / 1d10 + STR or DEX Physical.
lore: A bearded head on an ash haft. It splits shields as easily as firewood.

name: Greatsword
text: +2 to hit, 2d6 + STR Physical.
lore: As tall as a child and twice as loud. You don't parry it; you get out of its way.

name: Glaive
text: +2 to hit, 1d10 + STR Physical.
lore: A blade on a long pole. It keeps the enemy at a distance, where it should be.

name: Longbow
text: +2 to hit, range 150/600 ft, 1d8 + DEX Physical.
lore: Yew, horn and patience. A trained archer drops a charging boar before it closes.

name: Sling
text: +2 to hit, range 30/120 ft, 1d6 + DEX Physical.
lore: A strip of leather and a pouch of stones. Shepherds have killed giants with less.

name: Javelins
text: +2 to hit, thrown 30/120 ft, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical.
lore: A bundle of light spears, made to be thrown first and asked about later.

name: Spellguard Staff
text: +2 to hit, 1d6 / 1d8 + INT or WIL Physical. While you hold it, it counts as an empty Hand for casting from a Spellbook.
lore: Runes run along its grain. The wood remembers the shape of a casting hand.

name: Traveler's Lute
text: 1 extra Resolve (short rest). Your Anthems reach 60 ft instead of 30 ft.
lore: Its varnish is worn where a hundred hands have strummed it. The tunes carry far.

name: Greatclub
text: +2 to hit, 1d10 + STR Physical.
lore: A tree limb with ambitions. What it hits stays down for a while.

name: Gladius
text: +2 to hit, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical. Close Order: +1d4 damage while an ally is engaged with the same creature.
lore: A soldier's sword, short and wide, made for fighting shoulder to shoulder.

name: Boarspear
text: +3 to hit, 1d8 / 1d10 + STR Physical. Brace: your opportunity attacks with it deal +1d8 damage.
lore: Its crossbar stops a charging beast on the point. Hunters set it, then wait.

name: Pilum
text: +3 to hit, thrown 30/120 ft, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical. Pierce: on a hit, a Shield the target holds gives no bonus until it spends an action to pull the pilum free.
lore: A soft iron shank bends on impact, so the spear can't be thrown back, and the shield can't be raised.

name: Shortbow
text: +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft, 1d6 + DEX Physical.
lore: Light enough to shoot from the saddle or from the treetops.

name: Greataxe
text: +2 to hit, 1d12 + STR Physical.
lore: A crescent of iron on a heavy haft. One swing, one problem fewer.

name: Fine Bow
text: +2 to hit, range 150/600 ft, 1d10 + DEX Physical.
lore: Horn, sinew and years of an archer's patience. Only steady fingers can draw it.

name: Wand
text: +2 to hit, range 60/120 ft, 1d8 + INT Lightning.
lore: A rod of black wood capped with copper. It hums in a thinking hand and crackles when pointed.

name: Ring of Warding
text: Reaction (2/S.R.), when an attack hits you: +2 to the targeted Defense against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.
lore: A band of cold silver. It tightens around the finger just before the blow lands.

name: Guild Signet
text: Action (1/L.R.), in a settlement where the guild operates: a contact finds you within 1 hour. They share one fact the guild would know, or hide you for a night.
lore: Press it into wax and doors open. Lose it, and someone comes asking why.

name: Shard Bandolier
text: Your Pack holds up to 5 Shards instead of 3, within its usual 8 pieces.
lore: Leather straps padded for crystal. Shards clink softly against each other as you walk.

name: Holy Amulet
text: 1 extra Resolve (short rest). Your Cues reach 90 ft instead of 60 ft.
lore: A blessed token on a worn cord. Prayers spoken over it seem to travel further.

name: Boots of the Long Stride
text: Reaction (1/S.R.): Move.
lore: Soft boots that never wear out. Every few steps, one lands farther than it should.

name: Ring of Sparks
text: Reaction (1/S.R.), when a creature within 5 ft hits you: it takes 2d6 Lightning.
lore: Copper wire coiled around a blue stone. It bites whoever lays a hand on its wearer.

name: Dancer's Bells
text: 1 extra Resolve (short rest). Your Dirges reach 90 ft instead of 60 ft.
lore: A string of tiny bells for the ankle. Their jingle gets under an enemy's skin.

name: Potion of Healing
text: Action: drink it, or give it to a creature within 5 ft. It regains 2d4 + 2 HP.
lore: Red and faintly warm, it tastes of iron and cherries. Shake before drinking.

name: Coin Pouch
text: Holds up to 100 gp.
lore: A drawstring purse of good leather. Its weight is the only friend some people have.

name: Writ of Favor
text: A sealed letter from a noble house, a guild or a temple. Show it to one of its members: they grant one reasonable request (shelter, an audience, safe passage, a loan up to 100 gp).
lore: Heavy paper, a heavy seal. A debt someone important promised to repay.

name: Greater Potion of Healing
text: Action: drink it, or give it to a creature within 5 ft. It regains 4d4 + 4 HP.
lore: Deep crimson and almost hot to hold. Wounds close while you're still swallowing.

name: Restorative Salve
text: Action: spread it on a creature within 5 ft. Heal one of its Wounds.
lore: Bitter herbs, river clay and a healer's patience, sealed in a tin.

name: Pocket Sand
text: Reaction: throw it at a creature within 5 ft. Attack (DEX or WIL + 2) against its DEX Defense: on a hit, it has −2 on attacks until the end of its next turn.
lore: The oldest trick there is. It still works.

name: Alchemist's Fire Recipe
text: Reaction: throw a flask up to 30 ft. Make one attack (DEX or INT + 3) against the DEX Defense of each creature within 5 ft of the impact: 2d6 Fire on a hit, half on a miss.
lore: Three corked flasks and the knowledge to fill them. Keep them away from the campfire.

name: Springheel
text: Your jump distances are doubled, and you never need a running start.
lore: It came from someone who never learned to walk, only to bound.

name: Stone Blood
text: +2 STR Defense against poison and disease.
lore: Taken from a taster at a poisoner's court. Nothing in a cup ever hurt them again.

name: Iron Will
text: +2 WIL Defense against fear and mind control.
lore: The resolve of someone who stared down terrors and did not blink.

name: Clear Mind
text: +2 INT Defense against illusions and confusion.
lore: A mind that sees through mist and mirrors. Illusions slide off it like rain.

name: Cleave
text: 1/S.R., when your melee attack drops a creature to 0 HP: make one melee attack against another creature within your reach.
lore: A soldier's reflex: when one foe falls, the blade is already moving to the next.

name: Steady Aim
text: Reaction (2/S.R.): your next ranged attack this turn has +2 to hit.
lore: A hunter's breath, held between heartbeats, until the arrow flies.

name: Shield Bash
text: Reaction (1/S.R.), when you take the Attack action while holding a Shield: Shove a creature within 5 ft.
lore: Shields aren't only for hiding behind. A veteran knows the rim is a weapon too.

name: Battle Hymn
text: 2/S.R., when you hit with a weapon attack: up to 3 allies within 30 ft who can hear you have +2 on their next attack before the end of your next turn.
lore: A warrior's chant that rose with every strike, until the whole line sang along.

name: Rallying Cry
text: Rally as a loose Anthem. Action (1/S.R.): Duration 1 minute. Up to 3 allies within 30 ft have +2 on attacks.
lore: One voice that turns a rout into a charge. It remembers every battlefield it saved.

name: Shield Wall
text: Reaction (1/S.R.), when an attack hits an ally within 5 ft while you hold a Shield: +2 to the targeted Defense against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.
lore: Learned in the front rank, where your shield guards the friend beside you.

name: Cat Burglar
text: +2 on checks to sneak, climb or pick locks.
lore: The habits of someone who never used a door if a window would do.

name: Renowned
text: +2 on checks to persuade, haggle, gather rumors or perform.
lore: A name that opens doors. Everyone has heard the stories, true or not.

name: Sailor
text: +2 on checks to swim, climb, navigate or gather rumors.
lore: Salt in the blood, knots in the fingers, and a tavern story for every port.

name: Street Urchin
text: +2 on checks to pick pockets, sneak, read intentions or gather rumors.
lore: Taught by gutters and hunger. Nobody sees a child in the crowd until their purse is gone.

name: Hunter
text: +2 on checks to track, notice, sneak or handle animals.
lore: Broken twigs, bent grass, the hush before a deer bolts. The wild speaks; this one listens.

name: Physician
text: +2 on checks to treat wounds, recall lore, read intentions or persuade.
lore: Steady hands and a calm voice, honed over a thousand sickbeds.

name: Barkeep
text: +2 on checks to read intentions, gather rumors, intimidate or lift.
lore: Years behind the bar teach a lot: who lies, who drinks, who will start the fight.

name: Smith
text: +2 on checks to lift, break, haggle or recall lore.
lore: The forge's wisdom: the weight of iron, the price of iron, where iron breaks.

name: Mountaineer
text: +2 on checks to climb, endure, navigate or balance.
lore: Thin air and sheer cliffs were a home to them. The mountain never won.

name: Twin Strike
text: Once per turn, when you take the Attack action, make one extra attack.
lore: A blade master's rhythm: a feint and a cut, so fast they sound like one blow.

name: Second Wind
text: Action (1/S.R.): regain 1d10 + 3 HP.
lore: When others lie down, this one gets back up. Pain is a problem for later.

name: Wiry
lore: Lean, ropy strength. There was never much meat on them, but they never tired.

name: Night Eyes
lore: Eyes from something that lived in the dark. Shadows turn to shapes, then to detail.

name: Sellsword
text: +3 on checks to intimidate, endure, haggle or gather rumors.
lore: Hard years selling a blade to whoever paid. You learn the price of everything, and of everyone.

name: Acrobat
text: +3 on checks to tumble, balance, jump or perform.
lore: From a traveling troupe: flips, falls and a crowd that gasped every night.

name: Slippery
text: Reaction (2/S.R.): move up to half your Speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
lore: A knack for being somewhere else when the blow arrives.

name: Hedge Witch
text: 1 extra spell point (long rest). +3 on checks to handle animals, recall lore, treat wounds or deceive.
lore: Herb lore and old charms from a cottage at the edge of the woods.

name: Sweeping Blow
text: 1/S.R., when you take the Attack action with a Heavy or Reach weapon: make one attack roll against each enemy within your reach instead. Half damage on a miss.
lore: The wide arc of a giant's swing. Everyone in reach learns to fear it.

name: Relentless
text: 1/S.R., when damage drops you to 0 HP without killing you outright: you drop to 1 HP instead.
lore: Something that would not stay down. Death had to ask twice, and it never asked again.

name: Pack Hunter
text: 1/S.R., when you hit a creature one of your allies is engaged with: it falls Prone.
lore: Taken from a wolf. It knows the moment a friend has the prey, and when to pull it down.

name: Human Grit
text: Stubborn (1/S.R.): when you fail a check, add +2 to that roll, possibly turning it into a success.
lore: Short-lived, stubborn and everywhere. Whatever they lack, they make up for by trying again.

name: Elven Blood
lore: Long years in a slender frame, and eyes that never quite lost the starlight.

name: Dwarven Blood
text: +2 STR Defense against poison, Shoves and Grapples.
lore: Stone-born and slow to fall. Their blood shrugs off what would fell a lesser body.

name: Halfling Luck
text: Lucky (1/S.R.): when you roll a 1 on a d20, reroll it.
lore: Small, cheerful and impossibly lucky. Fate seems to like them, and nobody knows why.

name: Orcish Blood
text: +2 on checks to intimidate, endure, lift or march.
lore: Made for war and for the long march after it. The dark holds no secrets from those eyes.

name: Hobgoblin Discipline
text: +2 on checks to march, navigate, stand firm or read intentions.
lore: Drilled from birth: a good soldier, a good scout, a good officer. Discipline is in the bones.

name: Conjurer's Book
text: Spell attack: INT + 2 Spell points: +2 (long rest) Max spell level: 2nd Casting needs an empty Hand.
lore: Spells copied in a careful hand, the margins full of warnings. The ink still smells of ozone.

name: Wanderer's Repertoire
text: Attack: WIL + 2 Resolve: +3 (short rest) Songs, poems and dances.
lore: Songs gathered at roadside fires and in tavern corners, sung by someone who never stayed long.

name: Acolyte's Litany
text: Attack: WIL + 2 Resolve: +3 (short rest) Prayers. Fate dice: d4.
lore: Prayers learned by heart in a quiet temple. The faith came with them.

name: Wildheart's Remembrance
text: Resolve: +3 (short rest) Beasts your body remembers. Shift: action.
lore: The memory of fur, feather and claw. The body knows these shapes, and longs for them.

name: Twisted Ankle
text: You hobble.

name: Bruised Ribs
text: Every breath hurts.

name: Pulled Muscle
text: You can't twist away in time.

name: Concussion
text: The world swims a little.

name: Shaken
text: You flinch at every shadow.

name: Deep Cut
text: Stitched, not healed.

name: Black Eye
text: −2 on ranged attacks and on checks to notice.

name: Broken Nose
text: −2 on WIL checks.

name: Torn Tendon
text: −2 on checks to climb, jump or swim.

name: Weak Grip
text: −2 on melee attacks.

name: Cracked Jaw
text: 1 less Resolve and 1 less spell point.

name: Nightmares
text: A short rest heals only a quarter of your missing HP (rounded up).

name: Broken Arm
text: Blocks one of your Hand Slots until it heals.

name: Broken Fingers
text: Blocks one of your Hand Slots until it heals.

name: Swollen Hand
text: Blocks one of your Jewelry Slots until it heals.

name: Cracked Ribs
text: Blocks one of your Item Slots until it heals.

name: Wrenched Back
text: Blocks one of your Item Slots until it heals.

name: Shattered Knee
text: You may never run the same again.

name: Skull Fracture
text: −2 on INT checks.

name: Internal Bleeding
text: You lose blood every time you move too fast.
